يتماوت (form VI)
# يَتَمَاوَتُ (yatamāwatu) /ja.ta.maː.wa.tu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَمَاوَتَ (tamāwata)
# يَتَمَاوَتَ (yatamāwata) /ja.ta.maː.wa.ta/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَاوَتَ (tamāwata)
# يَتَمَاوَتْ (yatamāwat) /ja.ta.maː.wat/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَمَاوَتَ (tamāwata)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
